hPDL1.why: the one input BCX measured; the baseline rung

hCA2.why: carbonic anhydrase II (3KS3): an alpha/beta fold rather than an all-beta one, and it carries one unresolved residue (126) so the ladder is not all perfect structures

hIL2R.why: the chain count changes, and 387 aa puts a 100 aa binder exactly at the 512 ceiling

hTNFa.why: TNF-alpha (1TNF): three chains, and a real drug target that lands just past the ceiling

hHSA.why: serum albumin (1AO6) at Sudlow site I: the largest single-chain target a researcher plausibly brings, and well past the ceiling

hPCSK9.why: PCSK9 (2P4E) at the LDLR EGF-A site: a two-chain drug target at 586 aa, and the messiest structure in the set with five gaps in the catalytic chain

hTF.why: serotransferrin (3V83 chain A) at the N-lobe iron site: at 674 aa it is the largest single-chain target here, and it is what takes the ladder past 704 tokens once the shipped path turned out to reach further than the published ceiling

hEGFR.why: EGFR's whole extracellular region (3NJP chain A, residues 1-614 of the mature chain = 25-638 of the precursor) at the domain III epitope cetuximab binds. This is the case the Anthropic x Adaptyv 2026 competition specifies, and the one a Wormhole user has to crop today: 614 aa plus a 100 aa minibinder is ~736 tokens by arithmetic, but the seam runs 768: BindCraft 2 built a 742-residue complex and it is the built complex that gets bucketed (measured 2026-10-01, one Wormhole Galaxy chip, offload, 8.282 GB peak, 200.5 s a round). With a 150 aa binder the complex is 774 residues and the axis is 800.

hEGFR_d3.fold: domain III (L2) of the EGFR ectodomain, a beta-solenoid
hEGFR_d3.why: the crop we tell a Wormhole user to make: hEGFR cut to residues 310-480, the domain III subdomain the competition recommends and cetuximab binds, with the same four hotspots as the whole ectodomain. Paired with hEGFR it isolates the token axis from target difficulty: same protein, same epitope, same binder length, 352 against 768.
